newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE TO TRADE ONE MORE STOCK.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE TO TRADE ONE MORE STOCK.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Tuesday another Romanian company would join trading this week bringing to 26 the total number of traded stocks.
The shares of Policolor SA dye maker would start being traded on Wednesday, a bourse statement said.
Policolor, a state-owned company based in Bucharest, has a share capital of some 41.4 billion lei. Each share has a face value of 1,000 lei.
Its majority shareholder is the State Ownership Fund, which has 51 percent, with the remaining 49 percent held by individual stockholders.
Policolor will be traded on the bourse's second tier, an exchange official said. The first tier, where listing criteria are tougher, trades only two stocks.
Brokers said the newcomer would add to market liquidity and expected it to arouse investor interest from the first day of trading.
"Policolor is a liquid stock and, moreover, it is a well-known name. I expect small and big investors alike to show interest in it," said a broker.
Over the next two weeks another four stocks are expected to join the exchange, showing new vigour this year after sluggish activity for most of 1996.
